settings.title: Notification settings
settings.pushLead: On this phone or computer, even when the app is closed. They stay discreet: no first name and no content on the lock screen.
settings.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Allow them for this site, then come back here.
settings.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
settings.ios: On iPhone, first add the app to your home screen (Share, then "Add to Home Screen"), then open it from there to turn notifications on.
settings.notConfigured: Push notifications are not available yet.
settings.error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
settings.emailHint: Email is used for the optional weekly digest.
settings.readReceiptsHint: If you turn them off, you no longer see other people's either.
settings.onlineStatusHint: Only visible to your bonds, and only if you both share it.
settings.discreet: Notifications are discreet by default: this setting is in privacy.
